objective: Bring the Rough Quartz to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.

description: Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Seer Ravenfeather as proof of our meeting. She will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast mountains.
Be patient, <name>. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
progress: Greetings, <name>. You would not return to me if you had not accomplished your task. May I be the first to welcome you fully to the first path of four that will forever rule your travels.
If you have the stone the earth gave to you, I will give you the totem it promised. If not, then I pity you. There is much pride to be had when you've fully dedicated yourself to the elements.
completion: The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you. Trainers found throughout Kalimdor will know when you are ready for greater knowledge and will let you know as much when you visit them.
But for now, take this earth totem, and a scroll to teach you your first ability.
